label: Scrapbook experience
tagline: Raster-heavy collage pieces - vaporwave, cottagecore, Y2K, lo-fi, internetcore, dreamcore, mood-board
description: Drives the RASTER-HEAVY part of a WHOLE-PAGE scrapbook build for raster-collage aesthetics that CSS cannot reach - vaporwave, internetcore, cottagecore, dreamcore, weirdcore, liminalcore, Y2K, lo-fi, mixtape-cover, zine, mood-board, lookbook, Tumblr-grade. Scrapbook is NOT an owns-surface family and NOT an iframe - it is a build MODE: the same way you build any app/website, except the surfaces are raster cutouts instead of CSS, the layout is freeform/overlapping instead of a clean grid, and it is animated + maximalist. The caller first builds the REAL index.html in scrapbook mode (shell-scrapbook-substrate + style-raster-cutout + a named aesthetic) with cutout slots marked ``; this orchestrator then commits a core aesthetic + IMAGE INVENTORY + motion/interaction register, cost-gates the user, and scaffolds the passes that COMMISSION every cutout (co-dispatching visual-orchestrator per inventory entry - the heaviest co-dispatch of any family) and COMPOSE them onto the real page (freeform/animated/maximalist). It writes NO runtime.html and creates NO iframe; the real page is the artefact. Inherits simulation-orchestrator's discipline (research-then-passes shape, hand-off split, single final QA+lens gate). PNG sequences substitute for transparent GIFs (frame-by-frame, sprite-sheet-animated); handcrafted raster headline strips are commissioned via visual-orchestrator. Two raster-richness minimums every interactive page commits by default: ≥1 PNG-sequence 'key visual' that loops like a transparent GIF (the live twitch a static collage misses) and ≥1 raster UI element with transparent background (button / nav tab / scroll arrow / sticker CTA) so controls match the hand-made imagery instead of breaking genre with a CSS rectangle. The research drawer enforces these via the `ui-element` role + `minPngSequences` / `minUiRasters` envelope fields; waivable only when the brief explicitly rejects motion or interactivity. interactive-polish-orchestrator runs LAST on the real page for the living touches.

triggers.rule: User wants a raster-heavy collage piece anchored to a named internet-aesthetic core (vaporwave / cottagecore / dreamcore / Y2K / lo-fi / mixtape / zine / mood-board / lookbook / internetcore / weirdcore) - where the aesthetic LIVES in the imagery and CSS alone cannot reach it. Top-level Claude builds the REAL index.html in scrapbook mode (shell-scrapbook-substrate + style-raster-cutout + the aesthetic) with cutouts marked `` - NO iframe - then dispatches scrapbook-experience-orchestrator to commission the cutouts + compose them onto the real page.
